author: PC Gamer
text:
'The experiences on console and PC tend to be roughly the same,' says Take-Two CEO in response to question about GTA roleplaying
Of course, in the case of Grand Theft Auto 6, the PC experience at launch will be a blank screen.

author: PC Gamer
text:
A month after Paramount acquired Warner Bros. Discovery, its merged game division is laying people off
Skydance Games has "made the difficult decision to scale down some of our projects."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Take-Two expects to make as much as $3.5 billion during the GTA 6 launch period
Pre-orders for GTA 6 are still "unprecedented," says the publisher.

author: PC Gamer
text:
A week after expanding its publishing division, Killing Floor studio Tripwire Interactive lays off 36 people
Tripwire said the decision to put people out of work was "a necessary one for the organization."

author: PC Gamer
text:
AMD users are reporting a misfiring utility is eating SSD health by 1% a month. AMD says a fix is on the way for its GPU drivers
No rush. SSDs are cheap as chips right now, eh?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Warhammer 40K: Rogue Trader follow-up Dark Heresy will launch at the end of January
Gettin' heretical with it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Cheaper OLEDs may be here even quicker than we thought as TCL CSOT says its new inkjet printing facility could be up and running as soon as this time next year
Previous rumours had it penned for 2028.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy highlights how the GPU company’s dealings are now everyone’s business
He used to sell gaming GPUs, now he's in the middle of a geopolitical quagmire.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Floppy disks are out, 21st century tech is in': The FAA is finally ditching 55-year-old storage
Better late than never.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Golden Joystick Awards return this Wednesday—here's how to watch them
A golden joystick would be pretty heavy, I bet.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The pillars of AI are shaking beneath our feet
Strap yourselves in, whatever happens next isn't going to be pretty.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Great news! Nier: Automata's install size is no longer 7x bigger than it should be (it was 366 GB)
2B, times 183, plus G.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Skyrim lead designer gives the most succinct summary of Bethesda's design I've ever heard: 'You're not playing my game, I'm making your game'
Though, to be honest, sometimes I want to play someone else's game.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Consider this blackened plug your weekly reminder to check your RTX 50-series GPU cables
And maybe buy a cable monitor, too.

author: PC Gamer
text:
MSI Maestro 900R PC case review
The Maestro is a monstrous PC chassis with premium pretentions it just fails to grasp.

author: PC Gamer
text:
World of Warcraft: Forever bumps dungeon XP from monsters by 50% after some community feedback I will diplomatically call passionate
Back on that grindset.

author: PC Gamer
text:
EVE Online's new expansion looks to make it simpler than ever to get into a huge space battle: 'Every 10 weeks or so, you're gonna know: I can roll up with whatever I have and go shoot some structures and have a big fight'
A proposition that's hard to argue against.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'I think we'd accidentally created the most hardcore extraction game of all time:' EVE Vanguard is taking hard-won playtest lessons into a '24/7 Alpha'
It's not early access, not yet. Super-early access.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Lead designer Bruce Nesmith says Skyrim was a hit because it was built on institutional knowledge from Oblivion
Maybe laying off people who know what they're doing is bad, actually.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Warhammer Blood Bowl has been delayed into early 2027
One more turn.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Jackbox Games isn't interested in AI development: 'All that is done by people, and we have no intention of changing that'
CEO Mike Bilder doesn't see AI as having much to offer Jackbox.
